# FTIGutzwillerProjection

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FTI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FTI/FTIGutzwillerProjection`

```text
FTIGutzwillerProjection, version 0.01

Usage: FTIGutzwillerProjection [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -i, --input-file : name of the file on which the Gutzwiller projection has to be applied
    --file-list : single column file describing a list to states that have to be projected
    --su2-spin : particles have a SU(2) spin

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (while happen .x.vec at the end of each stored vector)
    --gutzwiller-basis : express the projected wave function in th Gutzwiller reduced Hilbert space

tools options:

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
